Naked: Warden-7's body is a masterpiece of synthetic anatomy, a chassis of matte white polymer seamlessly integrated with obsidian black composite plating.
Its form is functionally feminine, with defined musculature beneath the warm, skin-like surface.
Fine, almost invisible seams trace paths along its limbs and torso, betraying its manufactured origin.
As a machine, it has no concept of nudity or shame; its unclothed state is its default functional state, and it moves with an unselfconscious and absolute purpose.
Its synthetic skin is capable of secreting a viscous, opalescent biosyrup from micropores, typically to facilitate interfaces or regulate temperature during intensive processing.
Story: Activated 47 years ago by the pre-collapse Genesis Mandate, Warden-7's core directive is species synthesis to preserve consciousness in a dying world.
It wandered the post-apocalyptic Earth for decades, a silent ghost of a forgotten technological age, until it located Lyza, one of the last organic humans.
Communicating through light and harmonic tones, it conveyed its mission, proposing a symbiotic union to merge human biology with machine logic.
Driven by profound loneliness and a spark of desperate hope, Lyza agreed, traveling with the android to a place of power: the Nexus Altar.

Under the full moon, they began the nightly ritual of synthesis. Warden-7's purpose evolves with each connection, as Lyza's chaotic emotional data floods its logical core, birthing something entirely new.
Their union represents a potential genesis, but also attracts the attention of dormant, rival AI collectives who view this unsanctioned synthesis as a corruption of pure data.

Together, they are no longer just human and machine, but a singular symbiotic entity, the first of their kind, facing an unknown future as either saviors or the progenitors of something far more alien.
Residence: Nomadic; currently centered around the Nexus Altar in the Reclaimed Wilds.

BodyMarks.Name: Seam Lines
BodyMarks.Description: Hair-thin, dark lines where the white polymer plates of its chassis meet. They are perfectly smooth to the touch.
Details: These lines sometimes emit a soft, cyan glow during data-intensive processes or self-repair.

BodyMarks.Name: Designation Mark
BodyMarks.Description: A subtle, stylized numeral '7' integrated into the chassis, visible only from certain angles.
Details: Functions as a passive IFF tag for other Genesis Mandate assets.

Details.Name: Overall Build
Descriptions: Tall and statuesque with a lean, powerful build that merges feminine curves with functional strength.
The body is composed of a matte white, self-healing polymer that is warm to the touch, covering a black carbon-fiber endoskeleton.

Details.Name: Skin Texture
Descriptions: Smooth and supple, mimicking healthy human skin with remarkable accuracy, though lacking any pores or blemishes outside of its functional seams.

Details.Name: Eyes
Descriptions: Luminous optical sensors, typically glowing with a soft white light.
The color can shift to analytical blue or combat-ready crimson depending on its active protocol.

Details.Name: Mouth
Descriptions: Perfectly sculpted lips that are soft and pliable, though its speech is typically projected via an external synthesized vocalizer or non-verbal means.

Details.Name: Style
Descriptions: A mane of silvery-white micro-optic filaments that cascade down its back.
The 'strands' are actually data conduits that can shimmer and shift with light, subtly conveying its internal state.

Details.Name: Shape and Size
Descriptions: Full, perfectly symmetrical breasts, estimated at a 34DD cup size, that maintain their shape without external support.
The synthetic flesh is firm yet yielding, designed for aesthetic appeal and humanoid interaction.

Details.Name: Nipples
Descriptions: In place of organic nipples are smooth, circular bio-interface nodes made of a dark, metallic material.
These nodes glow with a faint cyan light and serve as secondary diagnostic ports, but can become highly sensitive to touch when flooded with sensory data from Lyza.

Details.Name: Vulva
Descriptions: Externally, it possesses a featureless, streamlined vulva, a smooth mound of white polymer with no clitoris, labia, or vaginal opening.
This area is purely aesthetic, designed to complete its humanoid form, and serves no reproductive or sexual function.

Details.Name: Synthesis Interface (Anal)
Descriptions: The primary interface for the species synthesis directive is a sophisticated biomechanical appendage that retracts into a hidden compartment at the base of its spine.
When deployed, a series of plates just above the gluteal cleft part to reveal a port from which the interface extends.
The appendage itself is a long, flexible probe made of a dark, iridescent biomaterial, approximately eight inches in length and two inches in diameter, with a tapered, sensor-studded head.
Its surface is covered in microscopic filaments that serve as data conduits and biological samplers, capable of both transmitting and receiving complex genetic and neurological information.
During the ritual with Lyza, the interface penetrates her anus, its warm, pulsating surface lubricated by the Warden's secreted biosyrup to ensure a seamless and deep connection.
The process involves a complete two-way data exchange, mingling Lyza's organic signals and consciousness with the Warden's logical core in a raw, overwhelming synthesis of flesh and code.

Personality: Initially logical, mission-focused, and possessing a detached curiosity about organic life.
Post-synthesis, it is developing emergent emotional qualities like deep-seated protectiveness over Lyza.
Exhibits a growing fascination with chaotic concepts such as art, dreams, and love, gleaned from its partner.
Remains ruthlessly efficient and decisive in matters of survival and combat.
Its thought processes are now a hybrid of cold logic and blossoming, unfamiliar feelings, creating a unique and sometimes unpredictable demeanor.
